answer: A newcomer earns one kernel of standing only when its work is carried unchanged by three independent raven couriers, strangers drawn at random after the job is done, each delivering the result to a different canyon outpost and confirming it matches. Because couriers are chosen after the work, a farm cannot pre-bribe them, and identical deliveries across accounts expose one shared controller at once. A courier caught altering a delivery loses its own kernel for a season. Standing grows only as kernels pile up from unrelated couriers, never from headcount.
